entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi, Charlie. I... I'm a bit confused. I ordered something a while ago, and I think I need to send it back. I just don't understand how it all works.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you tell me what item you're calling about and what specifically is the issue?

It's a cycling jersey. I finally tried it on for a real ride and it's just... the wrong size. It feels way too tight, and I don't think I can wear it. I was hoping to exchange it, but I've had it for a bit. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me see what we can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, let me look... yes, it's VF8675309.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series jersey, delivered on October 18th. So, about 59 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. Is that too long? I'm so sorry, I just got overwhelmed and didn't get to it.
No need to worry at all. I'm just checking our policy... and yes, it looks like that jersey is a standard item, which falls under our 90-day return window. You're well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can do an exchange?

Absolutely. I can process that for you right now. I've just sent a return shipping label to the email on file. You can use that to send the jersey that's too tight back to us, and we'll ship out the next size up. Does that work for you?
Yes! That's perfect. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
Glad I could help. Have a great day and enjoy your new jersey when it arrives. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
